name: Himeno Yuuri
source:
The only daughter of Director Himeno.
An extremely shy and introverted girl. She has a slight fear of men and only has a child-like knowledge of sex. 
Although she has a quiet personality, she also has a strong-willed side, and if she lets her guard down, she can be attacked unexpectedly.
In reality, she loves her father very much.



[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040429210739/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku4.html]game's website, archived[/url]]
